video_title: Manu Ginobili joins Inside the NBA to talk Wemby, Coach Pop & more before Game 2

quotes.speaker: Manu Ginobili
quotes.summary_phrase: Manu Ginobili on the rapid growth of the young Spurs roster
quotes.excerpt: seeing them grow and get together that quick and mature like that is amazing
quotes.quote: I really did not expect this happening this year after you see the type of players that we have. Maybe next year or in two years, but seeing them grow and get together that quick and mature like that is amazing. So, I'm thrilled like everybody else in town, in the organization. It's fantastic to see the team in this situation.

quotes.speaker: Manu Ginobili
quotes.summary_phrase: Manu Ginobili on the team's culture and the young core's maturity
quotes.excerpt: he has the whole package. He's incredible and he's so mature for being 22
quotes.quote: They are always a resource, they are always available. We are all always available. Hopefully they talk a lot, but that young man doesn't need much. He has the whole package. He's incredible and he's so mature for being 22 that it's hard to understand.

quotes.speaker: Manu Ginobili
quotes.summary_phrase: Manu Ginobili on the impact of the San Antonio fan base
quotes.excerpt: you know you're going to have your fans supporting you no matter what
quotes.quote: Of course it's a boost in confidence. You know you're going to have your fans supporting you no matter what. And they came to, even in the moments where it was tough, they were coming, they were supporting us, and they always got our backs. Every time we are out there in the community, you can feel that affection, that respect.

quotes.speaker: Manu Ginobili
quotes.summary_phrase: Manu Ginobili compares his own game to Dylan Harper's skill set
quotes.excerpt: the talent that he has while in speed and strength is a very unique combination
quotes.quote: The amount of the talent that he has while in speed and strength is a very unique combination with that youth, being that mature, strong, and having that type of skill to in speed finish like that, both hands, something that I never had for sure. He's unreal.

quotes.speaker: Manu Ginobili
quotes.summary_phrase: Manu Ginobili on Gregg Popovich's relentless obsession with winning
quotes.excerpt: he was so determined, kind of obsessed with the game and with winning
quotes.quote: He was relentless. He was so determined, kind of obsessed with the game and with winning that kind of drove us so many years and get the best out of us. He and RC set the foundation for this type of culture and type of style and the responsibility that we have being the only team in the community.

quotes.speaker: Manu Ginobili
quotes.summary_phrase: Manu Ginobili on Tim Duncan's self-accountability and work ethic
quotes.excerpt: if he didn't have the type of performance that he expected for himself, he would get us together
quotes.quote: If he didn't have the type of performance that he expected for himself, he would get us together, he'd say that's my bad, it's on me, it's not going to happen again. And you would see him the day after, 8:00 a.m., shooting, shooting. He wouldn't talk to anybody, he would have his headphones, but you knew it was on.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Smith credits Manu Ginobili for popularizing the Euro step
quotes.excerpt: you might not have invented the Euro step, but you made it vogue

text_blocks.speaker: Kenny Smith
text_blocks.text: People might not know, you might not have invented the Euro step, but you made it vogue. You were the person, anybody at home, he was the first to made it vogue and make it part of the NBA game, the Euro step, right here, brother.
